title: Chunk provenance fanout tracing and redaction for tool-called streams
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: As we roll out tool/function calling and multi-sink structured outputs, streamed responses are touching multiple subsystems (serving runtime, tool adapters, console sinks). We need a telemetry approach that preserves chunk-level provenance (which tool produced which tokens, call boundaries, model vs tool attribution) while allowing downstream sinks (logging, SLO metrics, observability traces) to receive sanitized data. Current tracing links model request -> response but loses per-chunk ownership and causes either overexposure of PII or blind spots in per-tool latency accounting.
background_and_goal: Goal: Implement a chunk-level provenance fanout that emits per-chunk metrics and trace spans, attaches durable provenance metadata (non-PII) for correlation, and routes redaction-safe payloads to different sinks. The system must: 1) create a per-chunk span that links to the parent request span and to the tool-call span when the chunk originates from a tool; 2) emit minimal per-chunk metrics (latency, token_count, bytes, tool_flag) to Prometheus/metrics pipeline; 3) publish sanitized chunk payloads to logging/console pipelines with configurable redaction policies; 4) maintain a replayable provenance mapping for debugging retained separately from redacted logs (access-controlled).
acceptance_criteria: For a model streaming response that invokes a tool, each emitted chunk has an associated tracing span with: start/stop timestamps, chunk_id, parent_request_id, optional tool_call_id; spans are visible in distributed tracing UI
Per-chunk metrics are available with <100ms publish latency to metrics pipeline and include token_count, emitted_bytes, origin_label (model|tool), and dwell_time
Redaction pipeline can apply three levels (none, redact-sensitive, remove-payload) configurable per-customer and per-route; logs exported to console show only allowed level
A separate, access-controlled provenance artifact (chunk_id -> original_token_ranges -> origin) can be generated for support/debugging without exposing PII in normal logs
Unit and integration tests for span creation, metric emission, and redaction behavior exist and are automated in CI
Performance overhead on p50 latency for streaming requests is <5% at steady state and tail increase <10% under 99th percentile bursts
implementation_notes: We will introduce a lightweight chunk-provenance header attached to the internal in-memory chunk struct. At emission time we fan out 1) a metric event to metrics-ingest (protobuf minimal), 2) a tracing span to Jaeger/OTLP, and 3) optionally a redacted log payload to the console sink. To avoid amplifying IO we will batch metric events from the same connection with bounded latency and use sampling for full payload logging. Tool adapters must propagate tool_call_id on tool->model tokens. We will add LRU cache for chunk_id->provenance to support fast lookup for trace linking and implement an encrypted provenance blob storage for support lookups with RBAC.
tradeoffs_and_risks:
- Adding per-chunk spans increases trace cardinality: mitigate with sampling and downstream span aggregation.
- Storing provenance blobs has storage/retention costs; propose 30d default with configurable retention.
- Redaction rules are complex for arbitrary tool outputs; we'll start with structured JSON paths and regex-based rules and iterate.
work_log: 2026-03-02: Spike completed to prototype chunk header + OTLP emission. Proof-of-concept shows ~3% p50 added latency with naive fanout.
2026-03-04: Converged on chunk_id UUID v7, tracing span parent is request_span_id; tool adapters must set tool_call_id header. Demo recorded in meeting notes.
2026-03-06: Implemented batching of metric events and added configurable sample rate for full payload logs (default 0.1%). Integration tests written for metric payload shape.

2026-03-08: Design review with PM and Security. Security requested separation of provenance storage and stricter RBAC for access to unredacted artifacts. Added action item to add encryption-at-rest for provenance blobs.
2026-03-10: Began end-to-end test harness for tool-call streaming path; observed tail latency regression under synthetic high cardinality—investigating backpressure knobs and token-size limits.
next_steps: Finish provenance blob store with KMS encryption and RBAC hooks (blocked on infra quota)
Add aggregated span exporter to reduce trace volume in high-cardinality customers
Implement per-customer redaction policy UI hooks in Console (coordinate with frontend)
Load test with dedicated capacity scenarios to validate p99 under burst
notes_for_reviewers: Key areas to validate: the chunk header schema (backwards compatibility), sampling settings for full logs, and the proposed retention defaults for provenance. Security strongly recommends a threat modeling session if we plan to expose any unredacted payload retrieval to support teams.
